about: The Sword of Damocles art library: drawn art in the game's own style plus real ancient art under open licences. One record per item. Search with jq (see README.md). Facets place, people, gods, mood and era are worked out from tags and titles by tools/build-catalog.mjs, so treat them as a finding aid, not as facts.
